profile.headline: Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
Summary to be updated: Currently in Redmond, WA and working at Microsoft.

I have been working at Two Sigma Investments as a software developer in the Knowledge Management department. Most of my work consists of web technologies ranging from front end html css and javascript through the back end with web services, dbms and hibernate. (Mostly Java & Linux).

Previously I worked at Microsoft as a software development engineer in Messaging middleware (MSMQ & AppFabric messaging) for the last two years. 

I graduated from Stony Brook University which is pretty focused on Java and therefore I have gained a good background in both stacks of technologies.

Specialties: .NET - C#, Java, Algorithms, Web Development, Web Services, WCF, Networking, MSMQ, Game Development. Other technologies/patterns I have used include SQL, AJAX, Hibernate, J2EE.

positions.title: Staff Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
* Platform owner for the calculation space of indirect tax, owning the sales tax engine in
Quickbooks.
* Overseeing migration from a scattered monolith codebase into separate services called by
dependent teams and external developers.
* Built and shipped the first modernized service in the org, serving production traffic at 10M+ daily
requests with 1K+ RPS spikes. This service makes use of new data stores, eventing & was tested through a
validation framework, as well as a suite of unit, integration and performance tests.
* Growing and mentoring the team with code pairing, architecture reviews, 1:1s, while still being hands on with code delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Money - Payments
* Built robust data pipelines for integrating information from diverse sources, creating unified reporting dashboards.
* Enhanced platform capabilities by modernizing key features and improving processing speed.
* Became a subject matter expert in payment and refund processing for multi-store operations.
* Improved system reliability and stability by developing new integration tests and automated monitoring tools.

Labor and Prep
* Founding member of team focused on insights into kitchen operations in the labor space.
* Architected and built data ingestion pipelines to power advanced business analytics.
* Developed and integrated APIs with third-party systems to centralize scheduling data.
* Created a suite of APIs and user-facing dashboards to provide insights into staff performance and optimize resource allocation.
* Built a comprehensive, multi-location dashboard to track key financial metrics and inform strategic business decisions.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Azure IoT solutions in both PaaS and SaaS style offerings (Remote Monitoring and Azure IoT Central). 
● Owned several features throughout the system including Edge device configuration, Rule dispatching, and metrics/monitoring.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developing and maintaining experiences essential for customers to experience the best and latest content for them. (Java/Spring/JSP/Javascript/RequireJS/jQuery)
● Feature owner for all search related features on Audible.com (and international sites). 
● Lead developer on a number of personalization features including the improve your recommendations page at audible.com/iyr.
● Fixed data flows in order to support best seller rankings of Audible products in both Audible and Amazon marketplaces.
● Owned backend development for the carousel pattern that is one of the main components of the website and used in almost every page. Also took over front-end development as well specifically focusing on mobile usage and visually impaired accessibility.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Enabling the company to be more productive through the development and integration of productivity 
tools.
● Add Confluence (Wiki Product) into company build system. Build extra plugins, metrics, single 
sign on. Guide users on proper usage (both normal use and API/examples). (Java/Spring/Maven/
Velocity/Javascript/jQuery)
● User Profile Management - Service for adding/reading properties of a user (extends active 
directory as a place for our apps to store common extended info). (Java, Jersey, GSON, Guice)
○ Internal company directory with people, bios, location, phone numbers, etc... (Initially 
done in ASP.Net C# but converted to HTML/javascript/Syte (open source)/jsRender 
with the User Profile Management as the backend).
● Internal Social Site used by employees to discuss extra curricular activities (PHP, Elgg open 
source framework).
● Created a Java codebase to facilitate much easier querying of Active Directory (LDAP queries) 
that is used by everyone that needs to do LDAP querying in the company (Java)
● Other Projects: Expert Directory (Groovy/SQL/HTML/Javascript), Like/+1 Service (Groovy/SQL/
HTML/Javascript), building search connectors for and maintaining Coveo (C#)
● Maintenance, building forms for, and some web parts for SharePoint.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development Engineer (AppFabric Messaging)
•	Feature owner for batching and enabling transactions in the SQL layer. (C# and SQL) 
•	Led the development of performance automation for the team. (C#)
•	Investigated performance issues using profilers and performance counters, and made fixes as necessary or delegated to the feature owner. (C#)

Software Development Engineer (MSMQ)
•	Investigated and fixed bugs in most areas of Microsoft Message Queuing (MSMQ) during the Windows 7 timeline and helped the team deliver MSMQ in Windows 7 (C++).
•	Took ownership of refreshing the MSMQ toolset which included investigating the most used tools, issues that were found, and also including 64-bit support (C++). 
•	Volunteered to assist in a backlog of protocol documentation issues by delivering over 25 fixes in a few weeks. Also became one of the few members on the team to author a new document (MS-NMFMB).
•	Delivered a demo using a complex event processing engine (StreamInsight) and WCF channels to calculate the VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price) on a stream of stocks.

educations.schoolName: New York University - Polytechnic School of Engineering
